name: Fatal Floors 👁️
desc:
You're hired! 

The job is simple, you and your team will be sent down to various floors deep in our facilities to recover valuables ores we were unable to bring with us while evacuating.

Just make sure to tread carefully, scans indicate the very entities that forced our evacuation still roam these floors to this day.

Good luck.


[Inspired by Minus Decendence, Lethal Company and 99 Nights in the Forest]
